svg.title: SVG Image created as t1-main-board-Charger and battery path.svg

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: TPS2121 input mux, BQ25798 2S charger, ship FET, fuse and the six battery contacts

g.desc: TPS2121 input mux, BQ25798 2S charger, ship FET, fuse and the six battery contacts

g.text: 1. Function: TPS2121 picks USB-C (IN1, priority) or the HAT port (IN2) into VBUS_CHG; the

g.desc: 1. Function: TPS2121 picks USB-C (IN1, priority) or the HAT port (IN2) into VBUS_CHG; the

g.text: BQ25798 charges the 2S pack and makes VSYS (6.0-8.8 V); the ship FET (SDRV) and the 5 A fuse

g.desc: BQ25798 charges the 2S pack and makes VSYS (6.0-8.8 V); the ship FET (SDRV) and the 5 A fuse

g.text: join the BQ25798 BAT node to the six battery contacts (feature blocks #7; ADR 0014, 0020).

g.desc: join the BQ25798 BAT node to the six battery contacts (feature blocks #7; ADR 0014, 0020).

g.text: 2. Absent state: never omitted. Pack out: with no adapter the BQ25798 is unpowered and the ship

g.desc: 2. Absent state: never omitted. Pack out: with no adapter the BQ25798 is unpowered and the ship

g.text: FET off, so an inserted pack meets a soft start; with an adapter it reports no battery.

g.desc: FET off, so an inserted pack meets a soft start; with an adapter it reports no battery.

g.text: 3. Drawn on three sub-sheets (blk.charger-*), sheets of blk.charger as the SoC's sub-sheets.

g.desc: 3. Drawn on three sub-sheets (blk.charger-*), sheets of blk.charger as the SoC's sub-sheets.

g.text: 4. SYS leaves as VSYS_SRC; the VSYS INA236 shunt (10 mΩ, blk.current-monitors) makes VSYS.

g.desc: 4. SYS leaves as VSYS_SRC; the VSYS INA236 shunt (10 mΩ, blk.current-monitors) makes VSYS.
